cues.sts_stand_tall: Stand all the way up at the top.
cues.ke_straighten: Straighten your knee a little more.
cues.ke_hold: Hold the straight knee for a moment.
cues.ke_thigh_down: Keep your thigh resting on the chair.
cues.sf_higher: Lift a little higher, if it's comfortable.
cues.sf_no_arch: Keep your back still. Don't lean back.
cues.squat_lower: Bend your knees a little more, if it's comfortable.
cues.push_lower: Bend your elbows a little more.
cues.row_further: Pull your elbows back a little further.
cues.bridge_higher: Lift your hips a little higher.
cues.leg_higher: Lift your leg a little higher, if it's comfortable.
cues.slide_further: Slide your heel a little closer, if it's comfortable.
cues.reach_further: Reach a little further, if it's comfortable.
cues.bend_further: Bend forward a little further, if it's comfortable.
cues.no_lean: Keep your body upright. Don't lean.
